game.title: Magic at Cavaliers, preseason
game.lede: What was checked and the result, in two or three sentences: which feeds, which devices, what production sent, what the replay sent.
facts: N alerts, N pushes, N devices

findings.title: One sentence naming the bug

sent.title: The alert's title exactly as sent
sent.body: The alert's body exactly as sent
sent.who: Who got it (which tracking choice, how many devices)
sent.lines: Later silent lines added to it, if any

wrong: What is wrong with it, in plain words. One paragraph per array item.
change: The proposed change. One paragraph per array item.

before.title: The alert as it is now (or: nothing)

after.title: The alert as it would read

findings.title: A finding with nothing sent (a note, or a robustness issue): sent can be empty and ba left out
change: What to do about it, or: no change yet, measure first.

right: What looked right, one line each: alerts that matched the final feed, merges that worked, counts that matched an independent count.
method: Recording: which feeds, how often, from when to when, and the file names (nba-<id>-2026-10-11*). This line may use simple HTML.
Replay: the recording run through the live tracker (GameTracker), how many test devices and which tracking choices.
Checked against: production's log and events (read-only, only if the user allowed it), the dev server, an independent count of the plays.
